### Context

The dataset we used for our "Ottoman Document Parser" project


### Content
This data set consists of 3894 characters; 1371 characters in Talik format, 411 characters in Rika format, 1974 characters in Matbu format, and 138 mixed characters.

Each image is 32x32 and in black/white format.

Characters labeled in their file names, last 2 characters before ".png" extension specifies the character itself.
"..01.png" means, that character is tagged as "elif"

### Authors

### Inspiration

This dataset is created in order to help researchers translate old documents written in Ottoman Turkish, and help them use Object Detection / Handwriting recognition on Ottoman Turkish documents.
